# Widget Co. Employee Handbook (Excerpt)

This is a fictional internal document used as a local test fixture for the
markdown ingestion loader. Its facts are invented and deliberately
specific, so a later retrieval-quality eval can tell a correctly-retrieved
answer apart from something the LLM already "knew" on its own.

## Vacation Policy

Full-time employees at Widget Co. receive 23 paid vacation days per
calendar year, accrued monthly. Unused days roll over up to a maximum of
10 days into the following year; anything beyond that is forfeited on
January 1st.

## Remote Work

Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week without prior approval.
Fully remote arrangements require sign-off from both the employee's
manager and the People team, and are reviewed every 12 months.

## Expense Reimbursement

Reimbursement requests must be submitted within 45 days of the expense
date. Requests submitted after that window are only honored with VP-level
approval. The standard mileage reimbursement rate is $0.67 per mile.

## Equipment Stipend

New employees receive a one-time $1,200 equipment stipend during their
first 30 days, and a recurring $400 annual stipend every January
thereafter for existing staff.
